items.title: Kenny Burrell — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I had Joey DeFrancesco, right? On with a trio with the organ

ctx.x: …And, plus the fact it was a big- celebrate my 75th so that was going to draw some crowds anyway. It was a tremendous week. I mean they had lines around the block, you know. And so I can’t say enough about it. Gerald is always easy to work with so we talked about the music—it was not any, not any problem—and figured out what to do and so I had stuff with the big band. And what else did…? I had Joey DeFrancesco, right? On with a trio with the organ; and I had Hubert Laws…
